title: notification.requested.v1
description: Legacy internal notification command. It has no producer and must not be exposed to merchants or receive new producers without a separately approved internal-command contract. Its required recipient field is raw contact data and must not be copied into parcel domain events.

parcel_id.description: Parcel the notification belongs to. Also stored in notification.notification_logs.parcel_id.

template.description: Email subject line and first line of the plain-text body.

variables.description: Optional values appended to the body as sorted key: value lines. Must be an object with string values when present.
